checks.name: sahay_coefficients
checks.detail: At q=8,p=3 use three distinct characters with values (1,-1,1), weights (2,1,3). Thirteen candidate product-series coefficients equal an independently enumerated convolution coefficient formula.

checks.name: sahay_exponent
checks.detail: lambda=sum ell_chi^2 equals candidate E on distinct primitive constituents; q-indexed distinct characters cannot share one primitive inducer.

checks.name: sahay_bad_prime
checks.detail: At every prime dividing the common modulus all chi(p)=0, so J_p=1 in both definitions.

checks.name: heap_degree_one
checks.detail: Heap k=3/2, e=(2,1), degree d=1 gives M=(3,3/2), E=45/4 and exactly the corresponding Barnes arguments.

checks.name: single_outer_weight_gap
checks.detail: Finite sanity check only; the exact infinite proof is descent: rational sqrt(2) would force both numerator and denominator even. Hence M=(1,sqrt(2)) is outside Heap's single outer k times integer multiplicity display.

checks.name: original_moduli_change_constant
checks.detail: For zeta(s)*L(s,chi0 mod 2), p=2 has J=2 versus primitive zeta(s)^2 J*=12, yielding the finite ratio 1/6.

checks.name: lifting_requires_restoration
checks.detail: Common-modulus q=2 tuple ell_chi0=2 has J_2=1; restoring the original zeta factor changes J_2 to 2. Relabelling the two original factors without restoration misses this factor.

checks.name: shared_phase_not_independent
checks.detail: Two restored inverse factors share one p=2 phase: joint phase mean 12, product of separate means 4.

checks.name: multiplicity_grouping
checks.detail: Repeated primitive inducer requires exponent 4, while incorrectly treating the factors as independent would give 2.

checks.name: all_zero_boundary
checks.detail: Removing all zero weights gives E=0 and empty arithmetic/Barnes products 1, so the prediction is the identity I(T)=T.

checks.name: heap_residual_quotient_-1
checks.detail: For epsilon=-1, diagonal-normalized residual=(1+epsilon*x)/(1-epsilon*x)=1+2epsilon*x+O(x^2). Its absolute linear prime sum diverges at s=1.

checks.name: heap_cross_regularization_-1
checks.detail: Extracting the quotient-character L(s,chi)^2 leaves the local factor 1-x^2, an absolute-convergence remainder; the original residual itself is conditional.

checks.name: heap_residual_quotient_1
checks.detail: For epsilon=1, diagonal-normalized residual=(1+epsilon*x)/(1-epsilon*x)=1+2epsilon*x+O(x^2). Its absolute linear prime sum diverges at s=1.

checks.name: heap_cross_regularization_1
checks.detail: Extracting the quotient-character L(s,chi)^2 leaves the local factor 1-x^2, an absolute-convergence remainder; the original residual itself is conditional.
